explication: This repository defines the OCI image format rather than implementing an image-building or distribution service. Its primary workflow is for an image implementation to produce a layout containing an index that references manifests and their configuration and layer content; validators can check format documents. The graph includes documented runtime and distribution handoffs, plus Go types and identity helpers. The tree and README support these capabilities, but the sampled code does not show an end-to-end image producer or consumer, so those implementation links are omitted.
